items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then you got a job with a territory band led by Bert Massengale

ctx.x: All sorts of adventures throughout the South. Then you got a job with a territory band led by Bert Massengale, also playing a lot of trumpet, but later moving to piano. Then is when you met Bill Bennett, in Jackson, Mississippi. That was mid 1950...
